whenToUse: People view same-format screens in turn, such as weather by day or photos.
There are few screens and they have an order.
People flick through with one hand on mobile.
whenNotToUse: Moving between screens of different kinds (use tabs or a bottom tab bar).
Other elements on the screen also slide sideways.
There are so many screens that reaching the right one takes long.

alternatives.name: Tabs
alternatives.reason: Moving between screens of different kinds.

alternatives.name: Carousel
alternatives.reason: Flicking through several cards in a row.

accessibility: Previous and next buttons do the same moves.
The current screen's title changes with aria-live to announce the position.
Screens out of view are inert, so Tab doesn't wander into them.
scroll-snap is a browser feature, so keyboard scrolling also stops screen by screen.
